```js
function normPriority(v) {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  const p = v.trim().toUpperCase();
  return /^P[0-9]$/.test(p) ? p : null;
}
function priorityCorrect(got, want) {
  const g = normPriority(got);
  return g !== null && g === normPriority(want);
}
```

- The oracle written as "p1" passes.
- The oracle written as " P1 " passes.
- "P2" against an answer of "P1" fails.
- An empty value fails.
- "high" fails.
